title: Independent DXF import of selected AC1021 TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP output
scope: Check whether LibreDWG 0.14 independently parses this repository’s selected physical AC1021 TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP ASCII and Binary DXF outputs, and identify the boundary imposed by LibreDWG’s versioned DWG encoder.

source.fixtureDisposition: Existing local DWG used as source. ASCII/Binary outputs and converted DWGs were generated under /private/tmp and are not committed.

reader.r2007Result: The DXF parser reaches the CELLSTYLEMAP identity, owner/reactor handles, all three cell names and IDs, and all three group-62 value 257 no-color sentinels in both encodings. The process then exits 1 with “encode does not work for R2007”; no DWG is created. This is parser/field evidence, not successful conversion.
reader.r2004Result: Both encodings exit 0 and the verbose import trace reports the same CELLSTYLEMAP identity/owner/reactor, three named cells and three no-color tags.
reader.r2004DowngradeReadback: dwgread 0.14 parses both resulting R2004 DWGs successfully, but each has zero CELLSTYLEMAP objects while the extension dictionary retains ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLESTYLE_CELLSTYLEMAP -> handle 5730. This is a lossy downgrade and fails graph closure; it cannot qualify the newer object for output preservation.

selectedOutput.localValidation: Both selected projections pass fresh local readback, source graph checks, dangling STYLE atomic refusal, and same-adapter correction/retry.

observedIndependentFields.mapHandle: 0x1662 in emitted DXF; remapped from source identity
observedIndependentFields.ownerAndReactor: Both refer to extension dictionary 0x1659 in the emitted DXF
observedIndependentFields.background: Three group-62 values 257 are parsed for the no-color background sentinel.

interpretation: LibreDWG independently parses the emitted ASCII and Binary DXF and recovers the selected fields. Its supported R2004 encode route drops CELLSTYLEMAP and leaves its dictionary key unresolved; its R2007 encoder is unavailable. Therefore exact independent DXF parser evidence is established, while independent version-capable output roundtrip, semantic acceptance, native application behavior, and whole-source qualification remain open.

validation.physicalAsciiBinarySelector: PASS for both encodings, including graph closure, atomic failure, and same-adapter retry.
validation.independentDxfParse: PASS for selected TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP fields in ASCII and Binary; R2004 conversion succeeds but loses the object on DWG readback.
validation.r2007Encoding: UNAVAILABLE in LibreDWG 0.14; explicit encoder error after DXF parse.

nextAction: Keep the AC1021 output profile exact and whole-source refusal intact. Obtain a version-capable independent consumer/reader that preserves and semantically resolves CELLSTYLEMAP, or move to the next independently ready local P4 implementation slice; do not treat the R2004 downgrade as qualification.
